description: For every valuation, every Boolean evaluation satisfying the atom, falsum and four connective clauses agrees with recursive evaluation on every formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval_unique.{u} {α : Type u} (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation α)
  (E : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α → Bool)
  (hAtom : ∀ (a : α), E (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a) = v a)
  (hFalsum : E Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.falsum = false)
  (hNeg : ∀ (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α), E A.neg = !E A)
  (hConj : ∀ (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α), E (A.conj B) = (E A && E B))
  (hDisj : ∀ (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α), E (A.disj B) = (E A || E B))
  (hImpl : ∀ (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α), E (A.impl B) = (!E A || E B))
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) : E A = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval v A
